description: This file implements a Gmail Watcher Service that manages starting, stopping, and monitoring a process that interacts with Gmail API via a 'gog' binary. It handles process spawning, error handling, configuration resolution, and periodic renewal of Gmail watch registration.

methods.name: isGogAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the 'gog' binary is available in the system.

methods.name: startGmailWatch
methods.description: Starts the Gmail watch registration with Gmail API using 'gog'.

methods.name: spawnGogServe
methods.description: Spawns the 'gog' process to serve Gmail watch, manages process output and restart logic.

methods.name: startGmailWatcher
methods.description: Main function to start the Gmail watcher service, including configuration, process spawning, and renewal setup.

methods.name: stopGmailWatcher
methods.description: Stops the Gmail watcher service, kills processes, and clears intervals.

methods.name: isGmailWatcherRunning
methods.description: Returns whether the Gmail watcher process is currently running.
